semantic.justification: Native ordered content sequence parsing and extension-first lookup plus actual SAX writer metadata output, including source whitespace and strict relation attribute names. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified. V4DQJW adds original ordered relationship-sequence reading: qualified root/child depth, required Id only, optional fields in Id/Type/Target/TargetMode order, duplicate preservation and ignored text. Writer uses this original XRelationshipAccess contract rather than oox::RelationsFragment admission. Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER238 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved.
